.venv/bin/python .plans/world-model-s1/prompt_capture.py /tmp/payload-kitchen.json
.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, re, difflib
a=json.load(open('.plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback/payload-base.json'))
b=json.load(open('/tmp/payload-kitchen.json'))
ok=re.compile(r"let herself into the kitchen|would not leave her kitchen|did not carve|across the kitchen from the back door|Place: Michelle's kitchen|takes place at Michelle's kitchen")
bad=0; changed=0
for label in a:
    assert len(a[label])==len(b[label])
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a[label],b[label])):
        for k in ('system','user'):
            xs=(x[k] or '').splitlines(); ys=(y[k] or '').splitlines()
            for line in difflib.unified_diff(xs,ys,lineterm='',n=0):
                if line.startswith(('+++','---','@@')): continue
                if line.startswith('-'): continue
                changed+=1
                if not ok.search(line):
                    bad+=1; print('UNEXPECTED CHANGE', label,i,k,line[:220])
assert 'takes place at kitchen' not in json.dumps(b), 'bare kitchen name in the opening'
assert "takes place at Michelle's kitchen" in json.dumps(b), 'kitchen name missing from the opening'
print('changed lines',changed,'unexpected',bad)
assert changed>0 and bad==0
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check tests
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check tests
